name: Breitfußalm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Breitfußalm in Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, the **Breitfußalm** offers breathtaking views of snow-capped peaks and lush alpine meadows. This traditional **Tiroler** mountain hut is the perfect retreat for nature lovers, hikers, and families seeking an authentic alpine experience.

Enjoy hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Käse** (cheese), and homemade **Apfelstrudel** while soaking in the crisp mountain air. The cozy atmosphere and warm hospitality make this a must-visit destination in the **Tiroler** countryside.

Whether you're exploring the surrounding trails or simply unwinding with a glass of **Apfelmost** (apple cider), the **Breitfußalm** promises an unforgettable escape into the beauty of **Tirol**.
